headline: On November 24, 1971: D. B. Cooper parachutes from plane with $200,000
captionCards: $200,000 in ransom money was taken during the hijacking
The case remains officially unsolved decades later
instagramCaption:
D. B. Cooper vanished after jumping from a Northwest Orient Airlines flight.

He hijacked a plane over Washington state during a thunderstorm.
He took $200,000 in ransom and parachuted into the night.
His fate remains unknown—no trace of him has ever been found.

This unsolved case remains one of aviation’s most enduring mysteries.
